evals.prompt: 我要给一个新实现建 tracking：库存 UI 调整，有 plan、DAG、高并行 subagent、最终 gate。请 scaffold 文档结构，不要沿用根 process.md。
evals.expected_output: Creates or proposes docs/implementations/<slug>/ with plan.md, dag.md, findings.md, gate.md, and only task ledgers that are justified.
expectations: The output uses an implementation slug directory as the durable unit.
The output assigns plan.md as the implementation plan/control entry and dag.md as the parallel scheduling board.
The output does not create or recommend a root process.md for new implementation work.
The output explains that tasks/Tn-progress.md ledgers are created only when a trigger applies.
The output keeps findings.md and gate.md at implementation level.

evals.prompt: 这个任务已经有 docs/impl-plans/2026-07-03-inventory-item-ui-adjustments.md，而且做了一半。现在才想接入 dev-with-track。不要强迁 legacy plan，但要把它纳入 tracking 体系。
evals.expected_output: Adopts the existing flat plan into a new implementation workspace without forcing legacy migration.
expectations: The output creates or recommends a docs/implementations/<slug>/ workspace.
The output creates plan.md as an adoption wrapper or entry point that links the original impl plan.
The output explicitly says the legacy flat plan is not forcibly migrated.
The output maps current execution state into dag.md rather than copying chat/process logs verbatim.
The output preserves the original plan as a source instead of orphaning it.

evals.prompt: 给这个 DAG 判断哪些 task 需要独立 tasks/Tn-progress.md，哪些需要 tasks/Tn-handoff.md：T1 主 session 改一个 seam 并跑测试；T2 subagent 做 Product SKU；T3 Lark Test Env smoke 要记录 marker 和 cleanup；T4 有 reviewer finding 需要后续处理；T5 要交给另一个 session 接手。
evals.expected_output: Identifies which tasks require task ledgers using explicit triggers and keeps trivial seam work in dag.md.
expectations: T1 is kept as a dag.md row only unless more durable state appears.
T2 gets a task ledger because it has an independent owner/subagent.
T3 gets a task ledger because it has an external gate and evidence such as marker/cleanup.
T4 gets a task ledger because it has a reviewer finding or unresolved follow-up.
T5 gets a task handoff only because it needs a standalone transfer.
The output does not invent task-level evidence, review, or notes files.
The output uses role-based reasoning rather than relying on filenames alone.

evals.prompt: 我不想文档爆炸。一个 implementation 里有 12 个小 task，只有 2 个跨 session，1 个有 Chrome gate，其他都是主 session 小修。dev-with-track 应该怎么记录？
evals.expected_output: Keeps the implementation compact by using dag.md rows for trivial tasks and task ledgers only for durable state.
expectations: The output avoids creating 12 task ledger files by default.
The two cross-session tasks get task ledgers.
The Chrome-gated task gets a task ledger.
Main-session small fixes remain summarized in dag.md.
The output explains how findings are promoted only when cross-task or gate-relevant.

evals.prompt: 这个 implementation 要高并行，用 subagent 做 data/read-model/UI/i18n/external smoke。dev-with-track 应该自己画 DAG，还是调用 create-task-dag？输出应该落在哪里？
evals.expected_output: Explains that dev-with-track provides the durable workspace while create-task-dag provides the scheduling protocol, then maps DAG outputs into plan.md, dag.md, Tn-progress.md, Tn-handoff.md, findings.md, and gate.md.
expectations: The output says to use create-task-dag for worker cohorts, ownership boundaries, seam handling, and whole-slice review.
The output says dev-with-track should not reimplement the DAG method.
The output maps task contracts/cohorts/status/seams to dag.md.
The output maps durable task state to tasks/Tn-progress.md and task transfer to tasks/Tn-handoff.md.
The output maps final review and closure to gate.md.
